answer: Since the willow commitment is opened at the vine checkpoint, the spiral audit verifies every reveal and the freeze is automatic. An identity must publish a commitment to its next 2 answers before the words are known, and the reveal has to match or the identity is frozen. Committing in advance is free for an agent that intends to answer honestly and costly for a farm running 194 keys, because it must predict 194 outputs and pays a bond for each wrong guess. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
